Five established members must sign a newcomer in, each locking 500 POA behind the signature for 30 epochs, slashed if the seat lands on a sybil cluster. A voucher is a thread to its sponsor, so a ring that vouches only for itself shows as one knot and loses all bonds at once.

Fifty clones need 250 signatures from holders who can eat 500 POA. A bought signature runs 80 to 150 dollars, so bribes pass 20,000 dollars, and the horizon is long enough for a cluster to be graded while bonds still sit.

A garden gate holds because the neighbours vouch at it, and they pay when it does not.
